$comment: Log vectors for @intellectif/lk-practice (criterion 4), generated by scripts/log-vectors.mjs and run by vectors/replay.mjs. `log` runs `steps` through createPractice(config), records each outcome (issues as code and path), replays the whole log after a replay-required step as a host does, and records the log, the final state, its replay, replayFrom at each checkpoint cut, the replay under `recompute`, status at each `now`, and reconcile against each named graph; `migrate` reads each row with migrateState. Floats compare at a relative 1e-9; integers, strings, null and every time and due exactly.

vectors.name: reviews to mastery: promotion, the mastered flag, the unlock of b, and a lapse in status
mastery lost to decay at the next entry on the skill, not on another
held evidence: confirmed, discarded, left held; failures and a lapse
late evidence asks for a replay, which confirms by look-ahead
host actions: prior, place, suspend, unsuspend, reset-skill
a leech suspends the skill at the threshold
evidence contexts, exposure and self ratings
the same log recomputed under another configuration
stored states read back, and each rejected input
